text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as we're walking through the
shopping
district...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Is it just me or are there more people
around than
normal? I wonder what's
going on.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a hot spring vacation! That sure
sounds nice.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I guess I have to!
Excuse me! I'd like to
try, please!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Of course! That'll be one raffle ticket!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, right. A raffle ticket...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Give me a minute. I'm gonna go do some

shopping!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser hurries back a little
later
with a raffle ticket in hand and
gives the raffle
machine a good spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I did it! I really did it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah! I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So when should we go?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
To the hot springs, silly! We're a little
busy right
now, but how about we go
once things calm down
a bit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the prize is a
coupon for two.
But even still...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Why? Is it weird for me to invite you or

something?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I figured you were the obvious choice for
this kind
of thing.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you take care of me more than
anyone.
You're like my partner or my,
uh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, you don't have to come if you
don't want to.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Then, let's plan the trip together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I can't wait! "Me, Trainer, and the
Misty
Hot Spring Mystery!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoops! It started sounding like a movie
title so
that just slipped out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Movies aside, now we've got one more
thing to
look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooh! First prize!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We didn't win the hot spring getaway,
but this
looks super delicious!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And the prize is for both of us, so we
should eat it
together. Let's cook it up
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! And if we're going to
cook, I might
as well make some sides
too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
On that note... mind if we drop by the
grocery
store on the way back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Matikanetannhauser prepares
a
delicious-looking dinner for us!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Deluxe carrot hamburger steak with
salad, corn
soup, and...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Somen noodles!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The hamburger steak is pretty hefty, so I
thought
it would go best with something
that goes down
easy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I chopped up some leeks and perilla
leaves too.
Hold on, let me get them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Odd pairing aside, all the food comes
out terrific,
and we have a great dinner
together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Second?! I was so close!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But second is still pretty good. The
carrots all
look so sweet and shiny!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And if we've got this many, then we
gotta share
with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Folks from the neighborhood used to
always
bring the veggies they grew to
our restaurant. I've
always wanted to
return the favor!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, ma'am. I'm sorry to bother
you so
late, but we harvested more
carrots than we can
actually use, so I
thought you might like some.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Did you come all the way over here just
to give
those to me? How sweet!
Actually, dearie, we've
got some extra
potatoes if you'd like so—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait a minute! Why're we even
roleplaying?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear later that their dorm was livelier
than usual
that night.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Awww, only third?! Drats.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh well. That's how raffles go, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
But since it's a special carrot and all, I'd
like make
something delicious with it.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The stir-fried burdock roots at my
parents'
restaurant is really good. Now,
what was the
recipe again?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm just gonna call them real quick!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hi, Mom?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, she makes me her family's
famous
stir-fried burdock using the
carrot and some
burdock root.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Awww! Too bad!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I figured we wouldn't get the hot spring
vacation,
but I would have at least liked
to win a carrot...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I guess life really isn't fair sometimes...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser is a little down in
the dumps
for a while after.
